secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Publishable (anon) key for the existing Supabase project https://heqxvqgztkaixtgezbcw.supabase.co — Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API keys. Public frontend configuration, safe in the web bundle, but must not be committed to the repo.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role key — server-side only. Needed to provision the initial administrator, inspect RLS and run privileged maintenance. Must never be shipped to web, APK or EXE.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_DB_URL
secrets.description: Supabase Postgres connection string (pooler, includes the database password) — used from the sandbox to read the existing schema and apply additive migrations + RLS policies. Server-side only; never shipped to web, APK or EXE.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.description: Supabase personal access token — used from the sandbox to deploy the admin-users Edge Function through the Management API. Server-side only; never committed and never printed (it lives in /run/base44/app.env).
